_meta.status: READY — 30 labeled pairs (50% positives, 50% negatives), drafted to cover all 7 memory types and the most common conflict shapes. Flip `it.skip` → `it` in conflict-precision.eval.test.ts and run once locally with `cd packages/triage-worker && npm test -- conflict-precision` to capture precision/recall/verdict for the v0.2 gate.

category_definitions.contradiction: A and B describe the SAME entity/fact but cannot both be true. One refutes, reverses, or invalidates the other.
category_definitions.benign_update: A and B describe the SAME entity, with B superseding A as a forward-in-time change. Both can be true at different points in time.
category_definitions.unrelated: A and B describe different entities or topics with no factual overlap.

labeling_guide.note: (optional) why this pair is labeled this way — helps debug false-positives during eval
